headline.text: Two prop-firm discount windows are open; the best saves about $38 on the next eval fee.

items.title: Builder 50K discount code
items.detail: A public code takes the one-time fee from $91.80 to about $73. Check the code on the firm's own page before paying.

items.title: ATLAS 25K promo week
items.detail: The 25K fee is $43 today; a seasonal promo may cut it by a third. Not a promise: promos end without notice.

items.title: Payout timing
items.detail: A funded payout can be requested after the minimum trading days. Waiting a week costs nothing but delays cash.

notes: Sample numbers, not real. Savings are one-time, not monthly income.
Promo codes change often and may not apply to your account.
